qa_pair.question: Using the SDG Global Database series for SDG indicator 3.1.1, by how many maternal deaths per 100,000 live births did the published maternal mortality ratio for the least developed countries, as a group, fall between 2015 and 2023? Round to the nearest whole number.

Among the countries of Middle Africa, which one has the lowest ratio of rural to urban primary school completion rate (SDG 4.1.2, primary education), comparing the two in the latest year that has both?
How many distinct data series on the UN System Data Commons report SDG indicator 3.2.1?
How many targets does Sustainable Development Goal 5 have?
Which country in the UN M49 sub-region Middle Africa has the lowest proportion of its population with access to electricity, in its latest reported year?
In 2015, the Southern Asian country with the highest maternal mortality ratio in the SDG Global Database recorded what ratio, per 100,000 live births? Round to the nearest whole number.
According to the UN's current list, how many landlocked developing countries (LLDCs) are in Africa?
